units.source_text: 昔日你还属于我的时候，

en.t: In the old days, when you still belonged to me,

units.source_text: 我在百货公司买一条领带，或者在厨房持刀收拾一尾方头鱼，

en.t: whether I was buying a necktie at a department store or standing in the kitchen with a knife, cleaning a tilefish,

units.source_text: 我都觉得自己不愧是一个幸福的女人，

en.t: I always felt that I truly was a happy woman,

units.source_text: 一股爱的暖流流遍了我的全身。

en.t: and a warm current of love flowed through my whole body.
